title: Explicit adjunction for localization on a finite-limit site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-topos] with finite limits and let $U\in\mathcal C$. Give $\mathcal C/U$ the localized topology: a family covers if its underlying family covers in $\mathcal C$. For a sheaf $A$ on $\mathcal C$ define $j_U^{-1}A$ on $\mathcal C/U$ by $(j_U^{-1}A)(W\to U)=A(W)$, with the same restrictions. For a sheaf $G$ on $\mathcal C/U$ define $(j_{U,*}G)(V)=G(V\times U\to U)$, with restriction induced by $V'\times U\to V\times U$. These are sheaves, these formulas define functors, and there is an adjunction $j_U^{-1}\dashv j_{U,*}$ with left exact left adjoint, hence a geometric morphism $j_U$ [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. At $W\xrightarrow{t}U$, the counit $(j_U^{-1}j_{U,*}G)(W\to U)\to G(W\to U)$ is the restriction $G(W\times U\to U)\to G(W\to U)$ along the graph $(1_W,t):W\to W\times U$.
